item.title: Ukraine used new ballistic missile in massive Moscow strike, Zelenskyy says
item.description: Smoke rose over Moscow on Sunday morning after a Ukrainian drone and missile attack that hit a major oil refinery among other targets.

item.title: Sheeran calls Gaza situation "catastrophic and unjustifiable" at Philly show
item.description: Ed Sheeran opened his solo concert in Philadelphia on Saturday with comments about Gaza, calling the situation there "catastrophic and unjustifiable."

item.title: 4 killed in U.S. strike on alleged drug-smuggling boat in Caribbean, Pentagon says
item.description: The latest attack brings the total killed in U.S. military boat strikes in Latin America to at least 231 across 69 strikes.
